propositions: Direct gated-close phase timings must be emitted in COMPLETION_VERDICT.metrics payload via the existing sidecar write without adding I/O, subprocess, network, event, or model calls

Instrumentation must thread an optional timing dictionary through close_ticket → _completion_precheck → _check_work_landed call graph and record ten direct millisecond metrics for structural scan, policy check, descendant scope, landing check, verifier call, git history, alias index build, ticket ref resolution, diff validation, and pre-verifier total
Performance constraint requires added bookkeeping to cost less than 50 microseconds per close using only time.monotonic_ns, integer arithmetic, and dictionary assignments

Existing callers must remain unchanged when no optional timing dictionary is supplied, and the duration probe must consume direct fields when present while labeling legacy records without direct timing as legacy_uninstrumented
